entities.name: Succinate-CoA ligase beta
observations: 386 aa bacterial protein; calculated molecular mass 40.3 kDa and theoretical pI 4.92.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q3SKM1, annotated as succinate-CoA ligase [ADP-forming] subunit beta.
Beta subunit provides nucleotide specificity and binds succinate; alpha subunit contains CoA- and phosphate-binding sites.
Forms a heterotetramer with two alpha and two beta subunits.
Annotated as cytosolic and part of the succinate-CoA ligase complex.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence match, sequence properties, function, complex, and localization

entities.name: Succinate-CoA ligase reaction
observations: Reference annotations support reversible succinate + ATP + CoA ⇌ succinyl-CoA + ADP + phosphate; a GDP-forming variant is also listed in reference annotations.
The beta subunit is not the complete catalytic complex and does not independently bind all reaction components.

entities.name: Succinate-CoA ligase beta properties
observations: Sequence-derived theoretical isoelectric point is 4.921 and predicted charge at pH 7 is -12.14.
Sequence-derived instability index is 27.09; these estimates assume an unmodified monomer.

entities.name: Tricarboxylic acid cycle
observations: Succinate-CoA ligase beta is annotated in the TCA cycle and succinyl-CoA metabolic process.

entities.name: ATP-grasp and Ligase_CoA domains
observations: Pfam scanning identified ATP-grasp_2 at residues 2–203, ATP-grasp_5 at residues 3–136, and Ligase_CoA at residues 262–381.
These domain calls support membership in the succinate-CoA ligase beta-subunit family but are not, by themselves, experimental proof of substrate specificity.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reference annotations state that each beta subunit binds one Mg2+ ion; ChEBI:CHEBI:18420.
Mg2+ binding is also represented by GO:0000287.
